response.courseDescription: 412 Strength Training Practicum I Clinical experience within the Strength and Conditioning minor, focusing on the basics of lifting and spotting techniques.
response.coursePrerequisites: BIOLOGY 315 or KINES 262 each with a C or better; KINES 264 with a C or better; KINES 311 with a C or better; KINES 411 with a C or better or concurrent enrollment; admitted Strength and Conditioning minor; current CPR/First Aid.
